title: Project Bootstrapping & Routing
description: Start here to understand how the API server boots using Hono node server and registers all API routes, Swagger UI, and middleware.

title: Authentication & Sessions
description: Understand the authentication surface powered by Better Auth, including custom middlewares to resolve session contexts and desktop app authorization handoffs.

title: Organization & Member Access Control
description: Explore how organizations, roles, invitations, and access limits are seeded, validated, and managed.

title: Plugin Subsystem Routes & Stores
description: Dive deep into the central plugin architecture system handling configurations, connector mapping states, sync jobs, and GitHub App discovery integrations.

title: Worker Provisioning & Vanity Domains
description: Examine the lifecycle routines that provision sandbox workspaces on Daytona runner agents, trace runner activities, and bind custom worker vanity domains.

title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server Router
description: See how route endpoints map OpenAPI tool manifests to standard MCP specifications allowing LLM agents to invoke local and remote connectors.
